headline: Long post-midterm campaign if talks fail
dek: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Axios: the US and Israel are preparing a possible week-long intensive bombing campaign against Iran shortly after the Nov 3 midterms if diplomatic efforts fail, potentially targeting leadership, energy facilities, nuclear sites and infrastructure. IDF chief Gen.
sources: Axios (US/Israeli/regional officials), via Axar and Arab Times carries
fault_line: Deal or 'another way'? Trump says finish the job either way -- is the week-long plan leverage for the Qatari mediation, or the default once Nov 3 passes?

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Axios: the US and Israel are preparing a possible week-long intensive bombing campaign against Iran shortly after the Nov 3 midterms if diplomatic efforts fail, potentially targeting leadership, energy facilities, nuclear sites and infrastructure. IDF chief Gen. Eyal Zamir spoke with CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper on Monday to coordinate. Trump to Axios Wed: 'We need to finish the job -- either through a deal or another way -- we will find out if negotiations can succeed.' Mediators led by Qatar (with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkey supporting) press Iran to allow UN inspectors into bombed nuclear sites in return for limited sanctions relief; the US wants enriched-uranium stockpile relinquished, Iran demands blockade lifted + frozen funds first. NO final Trump decision -- the report does not establish an operation is inevitable. Scored sig 2 as an incremental detail on the sig-4 0600-01 warning, not a new decision.
sections.what_verified: 1 declared family for the week-long/target-set detail: Axios T2. Axar and Arab Times are UNDECLARED carriers. AP T1 + WSJ T2 from 0600-01 corroborate the post-midterm preparation context only, not the week-long target set.
sections.what_disputed: Trump has not decided (Axios/AP/WSJ agree); Qatar draft was already dismissed by a senior Iranian official as 'unacceptable' (0700-02); Araghchi says Tehran still gives diplomacy a chance via the 7-day plan (1000-01). A prepared option is not an ordered campaign.
sections.why_matters: Update, not a new lead: fold the week-long target set + 'finish the job' quote into the standing post-midterm warning beat; never present the plan as an ordered strike.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to totw-20261029-0600-01 (AP allies warning) -- Axios detail: US/Israel preparing possible week-long post-midterm campaign if talks fail; Trump 'finish the job' quote

totw_analysis: Our read: Update, not a new lead: fold the week-long target set + 'finish the job' quote into the standing post-midterm warning beat; never present the plan as an ordered strike. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deal or 'another way'? Trump says finish the job either way -- is the week-long plan leverage for the Qatari mediation, or the default once Nov 3 passes?
